shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && git ls-files && cat package.json AGENTS.md

head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -C 4 'date-components|date-utils' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1
sed -n 215,232p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -30
npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@'^3' version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | tail -25; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4 peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | tail -12
npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json | tail -15; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4 version
npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@^4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | tail -5 && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar DatePicker

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar DatePicker; grep -E '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/{date-components,date-utils}/package.json; grep date package.json
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && cat dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -60; rg -n -i -C 3 'setup|styles|css|import' README.md | head -60; ls dist/docs -R | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && rg -n -C 3 'variant|Text' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -60; f=$(rg -l 'CalendarProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -3); echo "$f"; rg -n 'export.*Calendar|onUpdate|value\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

rg -n 'onUpdate\b|onUpdate\?|value\?:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n 'export interface ValueBase' -A 8 -r '' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -20
